maintenance_led.reason: Sells new steering and driveline systems to automakers (BMW, Ford, GM, Stellantis) for new vehicle production, not aftermarket.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private automakers such as GM, Ford, Stellantis, VW and BYD; end buyers are vehicle purchasers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows organically through new plants, technical centers and program wins with automakers, not a steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Safety-critical steering systems are designed into specific vehicle platforms; OEMs need requalification and long programs to switch suppliers.
